checks.description: TiberiumSurvey sends one screen vehicle along the survey route. Previously the only scouting was 34 seconds of ScoutMode (375-409s) heading straight for the enemy base, and the fleet never learned of any field beyond the three beside the yard. If this id is absent the survey never ran (no jeep/bggy reached ScoutMode or HarvesterEscortMode), and nothing else in this round can be attributed to it.

The whole route (about 17 points, roughly 52s at buggy speed on 16:9) is flown or written off within the match, because progress belongs to the side and a replacement surveyor continues where a dead one stopped. Present but not complete means surveyors are dying faster than they fly. Read the economy.survey-skip-point count beside it.

Home fields were worked out by about 550s. Income fell from 122 c/s (420-480s) to 37 c/s (540-600s) before the siege, and the lifetime rate was 36.5 c/s. It was 50.3 c/s up to the 939s nuke, which ended all spending. With surveyed ground to move to, the fleet should hold the rate past the home fields.

More ground to haul from makes it easy to get harvesters killed further from home. Mean harvester lifetime was 654.6s. A floor of 350 still allows heavier pressure but rejects a fleet that is being thrown away on distant fields.
The previous round got secondsWithNoHarvester down from 565 to 118. Surveying must not undo that by pulling the fleet onto exposed ground.
meanArmyValue was 1,520 (component score 0.253). Extra income from surveyed fields should show up as army held.

Fitness was 0.517 against a prior median of 0.295. Across recent runs income is the metric that separates the best runs from the worst, so a working survey should lift the total and not only economicRate.
